name: The Long Road
notes: Hints: you start each level with one; the chests at 10 and 20 add one each. A hint stays up until you drive, asking again is free, and a pulsing ring shows where to stop.
Scrap a route: drag it down onto the crusher, hold till the ring closes, let go.
New option: Replay ghost path. After a retry, your last try shows faintly, with arrows where you turned.
